title: fix(ci): skip post-merge fingerprint evaluation; heal via PR under master ruleset
intent: Stop dogfood post-merge/release CI from hard-failing on tree-local binary fingerprints that lag published pins; stop release-artifact-sync direct master push rejected by ruleset (PR required + signatures + update protection) by opening chore/release-bound-sync PRs instead.
stop_conditions: Do not skip fingerprint gates on pull_request events
Do not push healed artifacts directly to master
assumptions: Master ruleset still requires PR + required signatures + blocks direct update
GitHub App token can push to non-default branches and open PRs
